author: VanZandtVS
body:
I see people mentioning overleveling, but that's not such a big deal any more if all your concerned about is finding quest mobs. 

Odie, the developer of the game, recently added an item called a Seeker's Candle to the mimic enemy drop tables.  This item ups the spawn chances of mobs you have quests for.

There's really no reason to gimp your leveling anymore.


Other tips: 

Save all your perfect baldur and hardened steel till you reach t10.  There's less enemies that drop these materials, so you want to have a much as possible for when you get something nice and high level that uses these as upgrade mats. 

Join a kingdom and run raids.   Even just a few points of damage on a raid boss will net you a few rewards and some xp / gold / orns each time it's killed.   

Join a kingdom and buddy up with someone that's got a LOT of dungeons in view of their wayvessel.  If you're not familiar, the wayvessel is a building you can build that allows people in your party to teleport to your base so they can run your dungeons, use your shops and bestiaries, and help kill your world raid bosses.  It only costs a million orns or so to build, if I'm not mistaken, and having it and using it efficiently will drastically increase the amount of content you're clearing each day. 

Boss gauntlets net you extra orns / xp / boss drops like armor and weapons. 

Normal gauntlets reward you with summoning scrolls, mimic drops like assassins / heretics / growth jewels, and other nice stuff like the arisen monster tome. 

Both types of gauntlets have their place.   At t10 I usually run normal gauntlets for the summoning scrolls unless there's a bonus orns event going on.  

Progression feels slow, and every time you hit the next tier the new mobs hit like trucks.   Just keep going.  The game's way more fun with friends, especially if you find a nice helpful kingdom.


JOIN THE DISCORD.  That's capitalized for a reason.   There's a ton of really knowledgeable, helpful, awesome people that play this game.   Plus, the discord is a great place to find a kingdom or just chat with the community.

author: ItsEmperor
body:
I have been playing the game for just a little over 2 years now. My biggest piece of advice is a seemingly simple one: Play at your own pace. This is a great game, and people have different goals. Don't get burnt out trying to speed for a goal. Treat it as a marathon, not a sprint.

Another big piece of advice is to find a kingdom you really connect with. Playing with/talking to people really enhances the experience of this game. Find yourself a good group of like-minded folks and have a good time playing the game together. They may even be able to teach you a thing or two along your journey.
